limitations: Only the explicit diagnostic drives a separate centered 2kg sphere; production drone PID/forces/settings remain unchanged.
Variable synchronous solver steps, not fixed120 flight.
Command expiry uses deliberately old simulation timestamps, not wall-clock freeze or USB latency.
Displaced COM, live reset/destruction/rebinding, async lifecycle, missing/future input, drone motor/power/sensor migration remain unverified here.
No physical controller input, GPU rendering/performance, new hardware, or other physical PC validation.
